svg.aria-label: Callback. Two waveforms of the same voice: a live caller, whose signal falls to the noise floor between words, and the same voice played back down a phone line, where it does not because the room is still ringing.
svg.text: Who is actually on the phone?
A vendor emails new bank details. We hold
the payment and ring the number on the
oldest invoice, not the one in the email.
the same six seconds of one voice
between words the signal never falls back: a room ringing after each one
